That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital products

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a complete digital commerce stack you own and control. It combines free and paid tools into a unified system: hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets, file delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and crypto payment processing with NOWPayments. This architecture bypasses platform restrictions by operating at the base layer. You're not renting access — you're deploying infrastructure. No platform can suspend your account, hold your funds, or dictate your terms. This is permanent ownership, not temporary access.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack begins with static hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages — both free and globally distributed. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, handling order processing and file delivery. Orders are stored in Supabase (a Postgres database) or Google Sheets for simplicity. Files are stored in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, with signed URLs ensuring secure delivery. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which verifies on-chain crypto transactions and fires a webhook to trigger delivery. The system is modular: swap components as needed. The key is that no single platform controls the entire flow. You own the code, the data, and the deployment.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators in countries where Stripe, PayPal, and other platforms are unavailable or unreliable. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, or software in Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, or Zimbabwe, this infrastructure gives you a fully operational online store. It's also for creators who refuse to accept platform risk. A PayPal account suspension can hold your funds for 180 days with no appeal. With sovereign infrastructure, your store runs on code you own. No platform can shut you down, change your fees, or dictate your terms. This is commerce infrastructure designed for permanence, not platform dependency.
Stripe excludes 75% of the world's countries. Sovereign infrastructure includes everyone.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide free, globally distributed hosting. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, from order processing to file delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 store your digital products. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and automatic webhook integration. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys this architecture in 48 hours, including SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration and end-to-end testing. Each component is selected for reliability, cost, and sovereignty. The result is a stack that operates independently of any platform's restrictions.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing your hosting and backend tools. GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script are ideal for simplicity, while Cloudflare Pages and Workers offer more scalability. Set up order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets, and upload your products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing, selecting low-fee networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON. Test every step manually before deploying. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) handles this for you, deploying a fully tested stack in 48 hours. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to begin. This isn’t a tutorial — it’s a deployment blueprint for infrastructure sovereignty.

Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m in Nigeria or Pakistan?

Yes. This stack is designed for creators in countries where Stripe, PayPal, and other platforms are unavailable. It uses globally accessible tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments. You own the infrastructure, so no platform can restrict your access.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

NOWPayments is a payment processor, not a platform you depend on. If it fails, swap it for another crypto gateway. The stack’s modular design ensures no single component is critical. You own the code and can reconfigure as needed.
Is this stack secure for delivering digital products?

Yes. File delivery uses signed URLs from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring only paying customers access your products. The stack includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration to prevent phishing. Security is built into the architecture.
How do I handle refunds with crypto payments?

Refunds are processed manually by sending the equivalent crypto amount back to the customer’s wallet. Document your refund policy clearly. Since you own the infrastructure, you control the refund process — no platform intermediaries.
Can I scale this stack as my business grows?

Yes. The stack is built on scalable components like Cloudflare Workers and Supabase. Upgrade hosting, add more products, or expand payment options as needed. The architecture is designed for growth, not platform limits.
